messages.MSG0:
THIS IS A NORMAL UNCODED RADIO MESSAGE
TO LAIRA TYRIK.

BEFORE THE TRANSMITTER BROKE DOWN, WE
BEAMED ALL OUR ENERGY CARTRIDGES FOR 
THE JET PACK ONTO THE ASTEROID. EACH 
CARTRIDGE REGENERATES THE JET PACK 
ENERGY RESERVES BY 40% AND ENABLES 
SEVERAL SECONDS FLIGHT. REMEMBER ONLY
TO EMPLOY CARTRIDGES WHEN THE ENERGY
LEVEL SINKS TO BELOW 60%, AS THE REST
WILL BE WASTED. IN ADDITION WE HAVE 
TREATED SOME TRANSMITTER SPARE PARTS IN
SUCH A WAY THAT THEY CAN BE USED AS 
MINES WHICH REACT TO METAL OR 
MECHANICAL STIMULATION.
DETONATION IS BROUGHT ABOUT EITHER BY
CONTACT, OR WHEN A METAL MASS OF OVER 
42 KG FLIES OVER THE MINE.
THE BEAM-OFF UNITS BECOME ACTIVE 10 
SECONDS AFTER LANDING, AND CATAPULT 
EVERYTHING THAT THEN MECHANICALLY 
STIMULATES THEM INTO HYPERSPACE.
+
messages.MSG1:
YESTERDAY THE NEW YORK STATUE OF 
LIBERTY,WHICH HAS BEEN GREETING 
INCOMING SHIPS FROM LONG ISLAND FOR
CENTURIES, WAS COVERED AND OVERTURNED 
BY A TIDAL WAVE, 30 M HIGH. BEFORE THE
WAVE COULD REACH THE CITY, NEW YORK`S
WATER GUARDS BROUGHT ABOUT ITS ALMOST
TOTAL COLLAPSE USING BOMBS.
+
messages.MSG2:
THE EVER INCREASING ACTIVITY OF THE SUN
HAS LED TO AN INCREASE IN THE WORLD`S
AVERAGE TEMPERATURE OF 4.2 DEGREES. IF
THIS INCREASE SHOULD REMAIN CONSTANT, OR
EVEN RISE, OVER A LONGER PERIOD OF 
TIME, THE POLAR ICECAPS WILL MELT AND A 
RISE IN SEA LEVEL OF AT LEAST 23 METRES
MUST BE EXPECTED.
BECAUSE OF THIS 970 MILLION PEOPLE ALL
OVER THE WORLD WILL LOSE THEIR HOMES.
+
messages.MSG3:
DUE TO THE EVER INCREASING ACTIVITY OF
THE SUN, THE WORLD GOVERNMENT HAS 
STOPPED INTERPLANETARY FLIGHTS UNTIL
FURTHER NOTICE. IF THE DISRUPTIONS IN
TRANSMITTER TRAFFIC SHOULD CONTINUE, 
THIS WILL JEOPARDIZE SUPPLIES FOR THE
SPACE STATIONS TERCOM I AND II.
+
messages.MSG4:
TERRA FOODS INC.`S HUGE UNDERWATER
PLANTATIONS WERE BADLY DAMAGED BY A 
SEAQUAKE AT 7.49 AM. 
NOBODY WAS KILLED OR INJURED AS THE 
FARMS ARE COMPLETELY RUN BY ROBOTS. AS
A RESULT THE WORLD MARKET PRICE FOR
PROTEIN EXTRACTED FROM ALGAE HAS RISEN
BY 22.7 %. TERRA FOODS INC. PROVIDED 
12.1 % OF ALL ALGAE PRODUCTS REQUIRED IN 
THE WORLD. SHORTAGES MUST BE EXPECTED.
+
messages.MSG5:
AS A FURTHER INCREASE IN THE RADIATION
ACTIVITY OF THE SUN IS EXPECTED, THE 
CRISIS COMMITTEE OF THE WORLD GOVERN-
MENT HAS MOVED ITS SEAT TO ONE OF THE
OLD TWENTIETH CENTURY RADIATION 
SHELTERS. ALL CITIZENS ARE ADVISED TO
REMAIN IN UNDERGROUND ROOMS AS FAR AS
POSSIBLE.
+
messages.MSG6:
TODAY A STRATOSLINER WAS CAUGHT IN A 
WIND SPOUT DURING LANDING APPROACH TO 
PARIS-ORLY AND THROWN AGAINST THE EIFEL
TOWER, COMPLETELY DESTROYING ITS UPPER
THIRD. NONE OF THE 921 PASSENGERS AND
AND 1215 VISITORS SURVIVED.
+
messages.MSG7:
THE HURRICANE WHICH RAGED OVER NEW YORK 
YESTERDAY CLAIMED, AS WE HAVE LEARNED 
TODAY, A PROMINENT VICTIM. IT WAS THE 
CHAIRMAN OF THE SCC-TERRA RANTO NATHAM.
AT THE TIME HE WAS IN THE ROOF GARDEN 
OF HIS PENTHOUSE APPARTMENT, AND WAS 
SWEPT OVER THE ROOF EDGE BY GUSTS FORCE
12, WHICH WERE RAGING AT A HEIGHT OF 
670 METRES.
+
messages.MSG8:
YESTERDAY A NEW RECORD LOW WAS 
REGISTERED BY THE WEATHER STATION 
ANTARKTIS 7. AT -101.7 DEGREES
CENTIGRADE THIS IS THE LOWEST 
TEMPERATURE EVER RECORDED IN THE 700
YEAR OLD HISTORY OF METEOROLOGICAL
OBSERVATION.
+
messages.MSG9:
COSMIC RADIATION, WHICH IS CAUSED BY 
ENERGETICAL INTERACTION BETWEEN THE
SOLAR WIND AND THE UPPER LAYERS OF THE
EARTH`S ATMOSPHERE, HAS GREATLY 
INCREASED, AS HAVE THE INCIDENT ULTRA- 
VIOLET RAYS. AN INCREASE IN THE RATE OF
SKIN CANCER MUST BE EXPECTED. THE WORLD
HEALTH ORGANIZATION WARNS AGAINST 
EXPOSURE TO THE SUN FOR ANY LENGTH OF
TIME. UP TILL NOW 433 SWIMMING-POOLS
ALL OVER THE WORLD HAVE CLOSED UNTIL
FURTHER NOTICE.
+
